content.text:
I added the shortcuts, and a browser test in headless Chromium passed all 22 checks. Earlier failures were a bug in my test script, not in the app. The test covered the new keys and every feature from earlier steps: adding, sort order, overdue dates, filters, search, editing, saving after reload, delete and both bulk buttons.

- **What changed:** `/` now jumps to the search box unless you're already typing in a field. Enter in the todo box and Escape during an edit already worked, so I only labelled that code. I found one thing broken from an earlier step: since search was added, one saved todo with no text would stop the whole list from showing. Missing text now becomes an empty string.
- **What I rejected:** a separate Enter key handler. The form already adds the todo on Enter, so a second handler would add every todo twice.

result:
I added the shortcuts, and a browser test in headless Chromium passed all 22 checks. Earlier failures were a bug in my test script, not in the app. The test covered the new keys and every feature from earlier steps: adding, sort order, overdue dates, filters, search, editing, saving after reload, delete and both bulk buttons.

- **What changed:** `/` now jumps to the search box unless you're already typing in a field. Enter in the todo box and Escape during an edit already worked, so I only labelled that code. I found one thing broken from an earlier step: since search was added, one saved todo with no text would stop the whole list from showing. Missing text now becomes an empty string.
- **What I rejected:** a separate Enter key handler. The form already adds the todo on Enter, so a second handler would add every todo twice.
